rationale: C08 is a clear reusable drafting template for the child. Both telegrams offer a major-party presidential nominee periodic CIA briefings on the international scene, direct CIA leadership to arrange details with the nominee or a designated staff member, and restrict secret information to the nominee's personal knowledge while otherwise disclaiming restrictions or obligations. The close correspondence in language, sequence, and administrative mechanism is concrete and material. C03 and C09 concern foreign-intelligence administration but lack this candidate-briefing structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I believe it to be in the national interest, and I hope it conforms to your desire, for you, as the duly designated candidate of one of the major parties for the Presidency of the United States, to have periodic briefings on the international scene from a responsible official in the Central Intelligence Agency.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Because you are the designated candidate of one of the major parties for the Presidency of the United States, I believe it to conform to the country's interests, and I would hope to your desire, for you to have periodic briefings on the international scene from a responsible official in the Central Intelligence Agency.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive language and the central purpose of the communication are nearly identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have already requested the Director of the Central Intelligence Agency, Allen Dulles, to arrange procedural details with you or with some designated member of your staff.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have already directed the Acting Director of the Central Intelligence Agency, General Cabell, to arrange details with you or with some designated member of your staff.
shared_material.explanation: The same administrative mechanism is retained, with only the CIA official and minor wording changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Because of the secret character of the information that would be furnished you, it would be exclusively for your personal knowledge. Otherwise, however, the receipt of such information would impose no restriction on full and free discussion.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the information itself would be of a secret character and exclusively for your personal knowledge. Otherwise, however, the receipt of such information would impose no obligation of any kind upon you.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same confidentiality limitation followed by an assurance that receipt creates no broader constraint.
